_comment: Tier-2: BIOT_COEFFICIENT is a required Properties entry of the UPl elements and is NOT derived from the bulk moduli — set it explicitly. Pitfall (kratos.poromechanics #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The variable resolves on PoromechanicsApplication and not on core, and a Properties object accepts and returns the value the claim prescribes. Both bulk moduli it might plausibly be derived from (BULK_MODULUS_SOLID, BULK_MODULUS_LIQUID) are separate variables that exist independently, which is what makes 'not derived' checkable rather than rhetorical. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
